cards.ex: The film received high praise from critics for its originality.
cards.exUz: Film o'zining originalligi uchun tanqidchilardan yuksak maqtovga sazovor bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta hurmat va qoyillatish bilan bildirilgan maqtov.

cards.ex: The company has come under fire for its environmental policies.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya atrof-muhit siyosati uchun tanqid ostiga olindi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli tanqidga uchrash, hujumga duchor bo'lish.

cards.ex: The report was a damning indictment of the government's handling of the crisis.
cards.exUz: Hisobot hukumatning inqirozni boshqarishi haqida qoralovchi ayblov edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq va qoralovchi tanqid yoki ayblov.

cards.ex: She performed exceedingly well in the interview, landing the job.
cards.exUz: U suhbatdan juda yaxshi o'tdi va ishga qabul qilindi.
cards.uzDef: O'ta darajada yaxshi bajarilgan, kutilganidan ham a'lo.

cards.ex: The completion of the project was a real triumph for the team.
cards.exUz: Loyiha yakunlanishi jamoa uchun haqiqiy g'alaba bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyat, qiyinchilik ustidan g'alaba.

cards.ex: The experiment failed, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun biz boshiga qaytdik.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani boshidan boshlashga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: The concert was a resounding success, with the audience cheering for more.
cards.exUz: Konsert katta muvaffaqiyat bo'ldi, tomoshabinlar yana chorlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va aniq muvaffaqiyat, barcha kutganlardan yuqori.

cards.ex: The job offer rejection was a hard pill to swallow.
cards.exUz: Ish taklifi rad etilishi qabul qilish qiyin haqiqat edi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilish yoki ishonish qiyin bo'lgan fakt yoki tanqid.

cards.ex: The service at the restaurant left much to be desired.
cards.exUz: Restorandagi xizmat yaxshi emas edi.
cards.uzDef: Umuman yaxshi emas, ko'p narsani yaxshilash kerak.

cards.ex: The politician's career suffered a fall from grace after the scandal.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchining faoliyati janjaldan keyin obro'sizlandi.
cards.uzDef: Obro'si, hurmati yoki mavqeini yo'qotish.

cards.ex: He's always trying to cut people down to make himself feel better.
cards.exUz: U o'zini yaxshi his qilish uchun doim odamlarni haqorat qilishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir tanqid qilish, uni haqoratlash va uning qadrini kamaytirish.

cards.ex: Her performance was nothing short of brilliant.
cards.exUz: Uning chiqishi deyarli a'lo edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga teng, ya'ni deyarli aynan shunday.

cards.ex: The company's reputation has taken a battering after the scandal.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning obro'si janjaldan keyin qattiq zarba oldi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq tanqidga yoki muammolarga duchor bo'lish.

cards.ex: The play received rave reviews from all the critics.
cards.exUz: Spektakl barcha tanqidchilardan qoyilmaqom taqrizlar oldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ijobiy va maqtovga to'la taqriz.

cards.ex: Many small businesses fall by the wayside in their first year.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab kichik bizneslar birinchi yilida muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lish, maqsadga erisha olmaslik.

cards.ex: The new contract was a real shot in the arm for the company.
cards.exUz: Yangi shartnoma kompaniya uchun kuch bag'ishladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani yaxshilaydigan rag'bat, yordam yoki maqtov.

cards.ex: The company's finances are under the microscope after the accounting errors.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning moliyasi hisoblash xatolaridan so'ng diqqat markazida.
cards.uzDef: Juda diqqat bilan tekshirilayotgan, kuzatilayotgan holat.

cards.ex: The advertising campaign missed the mark and failed to attract new customers.
cards.exUz: Reklama kampaniyasi maqsadga erisha olmadi va yangi mijozlarni jalb qila olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan maqsadga erisha olmaslik.

cards.ex: To give credit where due, he did put in a lot of effort.
cards.exUz: Haqini berish kerak, u ko'p harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning muvaffaqiyati uchun unga minnatdorchilik bildirish.

cards.ex: He was on the receiving end of a lot of criticism after the interview.
cards.exUz: Suhbatdan keyin u ko'p tanqidga uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qabul qiluvchi yoki boshidan kechirayotgan tomon.

cards.ex: She gave him a withering look when he interrupted her.
cards.exUz: U unga gapini bo'lganda qattiq qaradi.
cards.uzDef: Qoralash yoki tanqidni bildiradigan qattiq qarash.

cards.ex: She was lauded for her dedication to the project.
cards.exUz: U loyihaga sadoqati uchun maqtovga sazovor bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa uchun maqtovga sazovor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He always finds fault with my work, no matter how hard I try.
cards.exUz: Men qanchalik harakat qilmayin, u doim ishimda ayb topadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsada doimo kamchilik topishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The promotion seemed like a poisoned chalice because it came with so much responsibility.
cards.exUz: Lavozim ko'tarilishi zaharlangan kosdek tuyuldi, chunki u juda ko'p mas'uliyat bilan birga keldi.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi tomondan jozibali, lekin aslida qiyinchiliklar olib keladigan narsa.

cards.ex: His honesty and integrity are beyond reproach.
cards.exUz: Uning halolligi va to'g'riligi aybsizdir.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday tanqidga loyiq emas, mukammal.

cards.ex: I have to take issue with your interpretation of the data.
cards.exUz: Men sizning ma'lumotlar talqiningiz bilan kelisha olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan kelishmaslik yoki norozilik bildirish.

cards.ex: Let's have a show of hands, who agrees with the proposal?
cards.exUz: Qo'l ko'tarib ovoz beramiz, taklifga kim rozi?
cards.uzDef: Qo'l ko'tarish orqali ovoz berish yoki fikr so'rash.

cards.ex: His behavior met with disapproval from his colleagues.
cards.exUz: Uning xulq-atvori hamkasblarining noroziligiga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilinmaslik, norozilikni keltirib chiqarish.

cards.ex: The singer received a standing ovation after her performance.
cards.exUz: Xonanda chiqishidan so'ng oyoqda olqishlandi.
cards.uzDef: Katta hurmat va hayrat bilan oyoqda turib olqishlash.

cards.ex: We will leave no stone unturned in our search for the truth.
cards.exUz: Biz haqiqatni izlashda hamma choralarni ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish uchun hamma imkoniyatlardan foydalanish.
